notes.title: Build the colony! Mars expands!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
What is this? You might be asking. Maybe you've seen Mars Power Industries already!
Consider this a free preview, if you're unsure about the full Deluxe edition. 
This is a standalone set of levels with a new house-building mechanic.
18 entirely new levels, a pleasant half an hour, for free, for everyone.

The Deluxe edition just got a big update with two new worlds and a DIFFERENT set of house-building levels! So if you had fun playing this, maybe you like the ideas contained within, you should be interested in the Deluxe edition!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/977230/Mars_Power_Industries_Deluxe/


Thank you for reading and thank you for playing!
Arek & Lukasz & Kuba & Piotr
